decisions: Clarify whether the shopping bag is for retail store use, event packaging, gift packaging, e-commerce inserts or brand presentation.
Prepare bag dimensions, paper/material direction, handle type, load requirement, print coverage, quantity range and artwork status before RFQ.
Avoid unsupported fixed MOQ or fixed lead-time claims; review the actual bag structure and project details first.
